# Stepper

A progress indicator for sequential flows: onboarding, checkout and multi-step dialogs. Each step derives its state from a single active value, and the connecting line fills as you advance.

```tsx
const [step, setStep] = React.useState(1)

<Stepper value={step} onValueChange={setStep}>
  {["Your details", "Company", "Confirm"].map((title, i) => (
    <StepperItem key={title} step={i + 1}>
      <StepperTrigger>
        <StepperIndicator />
        <StepperTitle>{title}</StepperTitle>
      </StepperTrigger>
      {i < 2 && <StepperSeparator />}
    </StepperItem>
  ))}
</Stepper>

{/* drive setStep from your Back / Next buttons; give the primary one a
    swapKey so its label rolls when the flow reaches the last step */}
<Button swapKey={isLast ? "done" : "next"} onClick={next}>
  {isLast ? "Done" : "Next"}
</Button>
```

## Installation

```bash
# One-time setup (tokens + lib helpers)
npx koalaui-cli@latest init

# Add this component (its dependencies come along)
npx koalaui-cli@latest add stepper
```

Manual: run `npm install radix-ui tailwind-variants tailwind-merge`, then copy the source into `components/ui/stepper/` and adjust the import paths to your project. Components pull `cn` from `lib/utils`, the `tv` wrapper from `lib/tv`, and (for multi-part components) `createContext` from `lib/create-context`.

## Usage

```tsx title="usage.tsx"
"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import {
  Stepper,
  StepperItem,
  StepperTrigger,
  StepperIndicator,
  StepperTitle,
  StepperSeparator,
} from "@/components/ui/stepper"

export function Example() {
  const [step, setStep] = React.useState(1)
  return (
    <Stepper value={step} onValueChange={setStep}>
      <StepperItem step={1}>
        <StepperTrigger>
          <StepperIndicator />
          <StepperTitle>Account</StepperTitle>
        </StepperTrigger>
        <StepperSeparator />
      </StepperItem>
      <StepperItem step={2}>
        <StepperTrigger>
          <StepperIndicator />
          <StepperTitle>Confirm</StepperTitle>
        </StepperTrigger>
      </StepperItem>
    </Stepper>
  )
}
```

import {
  Stepper,

## Orientation

Orientation is set on the root. `horizontal` lays steps in a row with a flexible connector; `vertical` stacks them with the connector running down the indicator column.

```tsx
<Stepper defaultValue={2}>
  <StepperItem step={1}>
    <StepperTrigger>
      <StepperIndicator />
      <StepperTitle>Cart</StepperTitle>
    </StepperTrigger>
    <StepperSeparator />
  </StepperItem>
  <StepperItem step={2}>
    <StepperTrigger>
      <StepperIndicator />
      <StepperTitle>Shipping</StepperTitle>
    </StepperTrigger>
    <StepperSeparator />
  </StepperItem>
  <StepperItem step={3}>
    <StepperTrigger>
      <StepperIndicator />
      <StepperTitle>Payment</StepperTitle>
    </StepperTrigger>
  </StepperItem>
</Stepper>

<Stepper defaultValue={2} orientation="vertical">
  {/* …same items… */}
</Stepper>
```

## With descriptions

Pair each `StepperTitle` with a `StepperDescription` in a vertical stack. Vertical orientation gives the supporting copy room to breathe.

```tsx
<Stepper defaultValue={2} orientation="vertical">
  <StepperItem step={1}>
    <StepperTrigger>
      <StepperIndicator />
      <span className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
        <StepperTitle>Account</StepperTitle>
        <StepperDescription>Your login details</StepperDescription>
      </span>
    </StepperTrigger>
    <StepperSeparator />
  </StepperItem>
  {/* …more items… */}
</Stepper>
```

## Density

Density retunes the indicator size, connector geometry, and text, without touching color or radius. `comfortable` suits onboarding; `compact` fits dense app UI and dialogs.

```tsx
<Stepper defaultValue={2} density="comfortable">…</Stepper>
<Stepper defaultValue={2} density="compact">…</Stepper>
```

## Loading & disabled

Set `loading` on the active step to swap its number for a spinner while it validates or submits. Mark unreachable steps `disabled` to block selection and mute them.

```tsx
<Stepper defaultValue={2}>
  <StepperItem step={1}>…</StepperItem>
  <StepperItem step={2} loading>…</StepperItem>
  <StepperItem step={3} disabled>…</StepperItem>
</Stepper>
```

## In a dialog

The headline use case. Reach for `DialogStepper` (from `@/components/ui/dialog`). It places the stepper full-bleed with a divider beneath and inherits the dialog's density. Put the step bodies in `StepperPanels` with the same `value`: the dialog grows or shrinks to each step and the body slides in from the side you moved. Cancel turns into Back after the first step, the last step names its action, and a final panel confirms the result before the dialog closes.

```tsx
const [step, setStep] = React.useState(1)

<DialogContent size="lg" density="compact">
  <DialogHeader>…</DialogHeader>

  <DialogStepper value={step} onValueChange={setStep}>
    {WIZARD.map((title, i) => (
      <StepperItem key={title} step={i + 1} disabled={i + 1 > step}>
        <StepperTrigger>
          <StepperIndicator />
          <StepperTitle>{title}</StepperTitle>
        </StepperTrigger>
        {i < WIZARD.length - 1 && <StepperSeparator />}
      </StepperItem>
    ))}
  </DialogStepper>

  <form className="contents" onSubmit={next}>
    <StepperPanels value={step}>
      <StepperPanel step={1}>…</StepperPanel>
      <StepperPanel step={2}>…</StepperPanel>
      <StepperPanel step={3}>…</StepperPanel>
      <StepperPanel step={4}>Workspace ready</StepperPanel>
    </StepperPanels>

    <DialogFooter className="sm:justify-between">
      <Button type="button" variant="ghost" swapKey={step === 1 ? "cancel" : "back"}>
        {step === 1 ? "Cancel" : "Back"}
      </Button>
      <Button type="submit" swapKey={label}>{label}</Button>
    </DialogFooter>
  </form>
</DialogContent>
```

## API reference

### Stepper

The root: holds the active step and renders a `<div role="group">`. Forwards all native `<div>` props except `onChange`; every part accepts `className`, merged last.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | number | - | The active step (1-based), controlled. Pair with `onValueChange`. |
| defaultValue | number | 1 | The initial active step (1-based), uncontrolled. |
| onValueChange | (step: number) => void | - | Fires when a `StepperTrigger` selects its step. |
| variant | "outline" \| "solid" | "outline" | `outline` is a ringed circle with a halo on the active step; `solid` fills every state flat. |
| orientation | "horizontal" \| "vertical" | "horizontal" | A row with the label under each circle, or a column with the label beside it. |
| density | "comfortable" \| "compact" | - | Indicator size (28 or 24px) and text tier. Inherits the nearest `DensityProvider` when omitted. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-orientation | `horizontal` or `vertical`. |

| CSS variable | Description |
| --- | --- |
| --step-size | The indicator diameter, set per density (`1.75rem` or `1.5rem`); every connector offset derives from it. |

### StepperItem

One step. Derives its state from the root's active value and its own `step`. Forwards all native `<div>` props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| step* | number | - | This step's 1-based position. |
| completed | boolean | - | Forces the completed state regardless of the active step, for non-linear flows. |
| disabled | boolean | false | Blocks selection through the trigger and mutes the step. |
| loading | boolean | false | Swaps the indicator glyph for a Spinner. |

| Data attribute | Description |
| --- | --- |
| data-state | `completed` (before the active step), `active` or `inactive`. |
| data-disabled | Present when `disabled`. |
| data-loading | Present when `loading`. |

### StepperTrigger

The clickable region that selects its step; omit it for a read-only progress indicator. Renders a `<button>` and forwards all its props; sets `aria-current="step"` on the active step.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| asChild | boolean | false | Renders onto the child element via Radix `Slot` instead of a `<button>`. |
| static | boolean | false | Kept for compatibility; controls no longer scale on press. |

### StepperIndicator

The numbered circle: the step number (or `children` as a custom resting glyph), a spinner while loading. When the step completes the glyph morphs into a check (both share one cell and trade scale, opacity and blur) instead of being swapped, and morphs back if you return to it. Forwards all native `<span>` props.

### StepperTitle

The step's label, which turns to full ink once active or completed. Forwards all native `<span>` props.

### StepperDescription

A muted secondary line under the title. Forwards all native `<span>` props.

### StepperSeparator

The connector to the next step, placed last in every item but the last; its fill grows when the step completes (and drains when you step back) on the same settle curve as `StepperPanels`, so the line and the body arrive together. Hidden from assistive tech. Forwards all native `<div>` props.

### StepperPanels

The viewport for the step bodies, a sibling of the Stepper. Built on the shared `useMorphBox` (see Morphing), it tweens its height to the incoming step and slides the new body in from the side you travelled on the same duration and curve, so resize and slide read as one move (a short fade under reduced motion). When the step change drops focus, it lands on the new step's first control. Forwards all native `<div>` props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| value | number | - | The step on show. Pass the same value as the Stepper; comparing it with the last one gives the slide direction. |

### StepperPanel

One step's body, rendered only while its `step` matches the panels' `value`. Keep field values in your own state so Back returns them filled. Forwards all native `<div>` props.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| step | number | - | The 1-based step this body belongs to. |

## FAQ

### Do I need to track the active step myself?

Only if you want navigation. The Stepper is controllable: pass `value` and `onValueChange` to drive it from your Back and Next buttons, or use `defaultValue` for a static read-only progress indicator. Step numbers are 1-based.

### How does each StepperItem know if it is completed or active?

It derives that from the root's active value and its own 1-based `step` prop: a step is completed when it is below the active step, active when equal, and inactive otherwise. The state is published on `data-state` so the indicator, title, and separator restyle off it with no JS measurement.

### When should I use the loading and disabled props on a StepperItem?

Set `loading` on the active step to swap its number for a spinner while it validates or submits. Mark steps the user cannot reach yet `disabled` so their trigger is blocked and the step is muted, which is how you stop people skipping ahead in a wizard.

### Do I have to wrap each step in a StepperTrigger?

Only for navigable steppers. `StepperTrigger` is the clickable region that selects its step. For a pure read-only progress indicator, omit it and place `StepperIndicator` and `StepperTitle` directly in the item.

### What is the difference between the outline and solid variant?

`outline` (the default) is a quiet ringed circle with a soft ink halo on the active step. `solid` fills every state with a flat tone for the bolder Calendly-style rail used in larger multi-step wizards.

### How do I put a stepper in a dialog?

Reach for `DialogStepper` from `@/components/ui/dialog`. It places the stepper full-bleed with a divider beneath and inherits the dialog's density, so you only drive its `value` from the dialog's own step state. Wrap the step bodies in `StepperPanels` with the same `value` so the dialog's height follows each step instead of jumping.

### Why do my fields come back empty when I go Back?

A `StepperPanel` unmounts when its step is not on show, so uncontrolled inputs lose what was typed. Keep the values in state above the panels, as the dialog example does, and Back returns them filled.

## Exports and dependencies

`npx koalaui-cli@latest add stepper` writes `components/ui/stepper/`. Import from `@/components/ui/stepper`:

- Components and helpers: `Stepper`, `StepperItem`, `StepperTrigger`, `StepperIndicator`, `StepperTitle`, `StepperDescription`, `StepperSeparator`, `StepperPanels`, `StepperPanel`, `stepperVariants`
- Types: `StepperProps`, `StepperItemProps`, `StepperTriggerProps`, `StepperPanelsProps`, `StepperPanelProps`
- Koala components it installs with it: `spinner`
- Koala lib helpers it uses: `create-context`, `density`, `hit-area`, `morph`, `motion`, `tv`, `utils`
- npm packages: `koala-icons`, `radix-ui`
